decision.reason: [ev-21e07cf98d97] says the ipcache high-scale mode is deprecated in 1.17 and will be removed in v1.18. That is enough for the change and the consequence. It does not say which flag, Helm value or config key turns the mode on, so no applicability condition can be written. The other items in the same section [ev-bcdbfe5ecd01][ev-b5054e15ad6c][ev-c082dfefeb1b][ev-b7f3339817fc][ev-9113ff586fec] cover other changes and don't say how high-scale mode is enabled. An upgrade-guide section, linked PR or docs that name the setting that enables high-scale ipcache are needed.
